title: ¿Y si Papi a la orden hiciera bien su trabajo?
logline: Un hondureño sueña con un país donde todo funciona, hasta que suena la alarma y hay un hoyo frente a su casa.
premise: Sátira en forma de sueño: si el presidente hiciera bien su trabajo, Honduras sería como Dubái. Humor sobre servicios públicos (baches, luz, hospitales), no acusaciones contra nadie.
setting: Honduras imaginaria del futuro: Tegucigalpa, San Pedro Sula y La Ceiba convertidas en ciudades de cristal.
tone: Comedia absurda, rápida, con groserías hondureñas y remate final.
visual_style: Hand-drawn editorial newspaper caricature illustration: confident black ink outlines with slight line-weight variation, flat digital coloring with soft cel shading, hugely exaggerated heads like a Latin American political cartoonist, bright tropical colors, subtle paper grain. Clearly a drawing, never 3D, never photorealistic.

narrator.voice_instructions: Hombre joven hondureño, ritmo MUY rápido y chismoso, tono burlón y sarcástico, como contando un chisme a un amigo. Hace una pausa corta antes de cada remate y dice las groserías con naturalidad. Español de Honduras, nada de acento neutro.

characters.name: Papi
characters.role: Caricatura del presidente, personaje del sueño
characters.visual: Caricature of a lean older man in his 60s: very large head on a thin body, tall bald forehead with a ring of short gray hair at the sides, thick gray mustache, long expressive nose, droopy kind eyes. Wears a light-blue button-up shirt with the sleeves rolled up, blue jeans and heavy black lace-up work boots (Timberland style, rounded toe, thick sole). Often carries a small Honduran flag (blue-white-blue stripes with five small blue stars) or a smartphone.
characters.personality: Campechano, siempre grita con alegría su frase de la suerte.
characters.voice_instructions: Hombre mayor hondureño, voz ronca y alegre; grita la frase con muchísima energía, alargando las vocales finales: «¡La rachaaa está activaaa!».

characters.name: Chepe
characters.visual: Young Honduran man in his late 20s: very large round head, short black curly hair, medium-brown skin, big expressive dark eyes, small body. Wears a wrinkled green pajama t-shirt (no print) and gray sweatpants.
characters.personality: Cansado de los baches y los apagones, sueña en grande.
characters.voice_instructions: Hombre joven hondureño, muy rápido y burlón.

characters.name: Don Chelito
characters.role: El amigo que piensa que Honduras está bien
characters.visual: Stocky man in his mid 40s: very large head, red baseball cap, thick black mustache, smug half-closed eyes, arms crossed over a plain royal-blue polo shirt. Small body, big belly.
characters.personality: Cree que todo está bien y no acepta críticas.

outline: Un solo episodio: sueño de un país perfecto, remate con el hoyo y el apagón, y la invitación a compartirlo.

episodes.title: La racha está activada
episodes.hook_text: ¿Y si Papi a la orden hiciera bien su chamba?
episodes.post_description: ¿Y si Papi a la orden, por fin, hiciera bien su puta chamba? 🇭🇳🔥 Tegucigalpa, San Pedro Sula y La Ceiba como Dubái. Mándaselo al cerote de tu amigo que piensa que Honduras está bien. 👇 Comenta qué arreglarías tú primero.

scenes.image_prompt: Extreme close-up of Papi's huge caricature face, eyebrows raised very high in comic surprise, mouth slightly open, eyes wide, golden sunburst rays behind him. His face fills the upper two thirds.

lines.speaker: narrador
lines.text: ¿Y si Papi a la orden, por fin, hiciera bien su puta chamba?

scenes.image_prompt: Chepe in pajamas stands on his tiny balcony at sunrise, jaw dropped, looking down at a perfectly smooth, spotless, completely empty boulevard with no potholes, no cars, glowing in golden light and palm trees along the sidewalks.

lines.speaker: narrador
lines.text: Despiertas un lunes, maje, y el bulevar está vacío. Ni un bache de mierda. Ni uno.
lines.delivery: asombrado, con el remate en 'ni uno'

scenes.image_prompt: Papi jogging joyfully along a turquoise tropical beach under coconut palms, a smartphone in one hand, one fist raised, wide happy open-mouthed shout, sand kicking up behind his heavy black work boots. Joyful energy.

lines.speaker: narrador
lines.text: Sales y ves a Papi corriendo por la playa, celular en mano, gritando:

lines.speaker: papi
lines.delivery: gritando muy fuerte, alargando las vocales finales

scenes.image_prompt: Futuristic Tegucigalpa skyline at golden hour: gleaming glass skyscrapers rising from green hills where small houses used to cling, one super-tall tower with a Honduran flag on top, flying cars gliding between the buildings. No readable text.

lines.speaker: narrador
lines.text: Tegucigalpa ya no tiene casas colgadas del cerro: tiene rascacielos de cristal y autos voladores. La Torre Catracha le pasa la mano al Burj Khalifa.

scenes.image_prompt: A modern elevated train glides above a clean San Pedro Sula street; below, a cheerful minibus 'rapidito' politely stops to let a smiling grandmother cross the street; Chepe in pajamas waves; in the background a cartoon fried chicken character with big eyes stands calmly on the sidewalk, not looking lost. No readable text.

lines.speaker: narrador
lines.text: San Pedro Sula tiene tren elevado, los rapiditos son educados y ya no hay choques, cabrón.

lines.speaker: narrador
lines.text: Y el pollo ya no anda diciendo: ¡dónde estooooy!
lines.delivery: imitando una voz de pollo perdido, alargando la 'o'

scenes.image_prompt: La Ceiba beach as a glamorous tropical Miami: turquoise sea, a carnival parade with colorful dancers and floats, and in the foreground a giant baleada (Honduran folded tortilla) wearing a small golden crown on a beach towel. Festive and bright. No readable text.

lines.speaker: narrador
lines.text: La Ceiba es Miami, pero con baleadas, y el Carnaval dura todo el año.

scenes.image_prompt: Chepe holds a giant electricity bill that is almost as big as he is, eyes huge with joy; behind him a glowing lamp is on and a living-room TV shows a football match with a cheering crowd. Warm cozy light. The bill shows only a big plain number one, no other text.

lines.speaker: narrador
lines.text: Te llega el recibo de la luz y es de un lempira. Y no hay apagón. Ni cuando juega la H.
lines.delivery: incrédulo, con el remate en 'la H'

scenes.image_prompt: Split scene in one frame: on the left a bright modern hospital pharmacy with shelves completely full of medicine boxes and a smiling nurse; on the right a school with a solid roof and tiny cartoon kids in graduation caps speaking happily with speech bubbles of different flags (no readable text). Chepe watches proudly from the center.

lines.speaker: narrador
lines.text: Los hospitales tienen medicinas, las escuelas tienen techo, y los cipotes salen del cole hablando tres idiomas.

scenes.image_prompt: Heroic low-angle shot of Papi on a hilltop holding a large Honduran flag (blue-white-blue stripes with five small blue stars) that waves in the wind, fireworks and sparkles behind him in a sunset sky, mouth open in a triumphant shout.

lines.speaker: narrador
lines.text: Y Papi, en medio de todo, levanta la bandera y grita otra vez:

lines.speaker: papi
lines.delivery: gritando muy fuerte, alargando las vocales finales

scenes.image_prompt: Close-up of Papi shrugging his shoulders with palms up and a small proud smile, eyebrows raised, soft golden light behind him.

lines.speaker: narrador
lines.text: Todo, solo porque alguien hizo lo mínimo: su puta chamba.

scenes.image_prompt: Dark messy bedroom at night: Chepe sits up in bed in his pajamas, hair messy, a phone alarm glowing on the nightstand, a power outage making the room dark; through the window a large pothole is visible in the street in front of his house under a dim streetlight.

lines.speaker: narrador
lines.text: Y suena la alarma. Hay un hoyo frente a tu casa… y se fue la luz. Era un sueño, catracho, a la gran puta.

scenes.image_prompt: Don Chelito stands with arms crossed, red cap, smug closed-eye smile and nose in the air, in front of a dusty street with one pothole behind him; comic contrast of his confidence with the bad street.

lines.speaker: narrador
lines.text: Mándaselo al cerote de tu amigo cachureco que piensa que Honduras está bien.
